sentences.text: Agentic AI is live at Toss Bank, which has expanded its AI chat agent to all customers to handle requests from card delivery tracking to loss reports.
In lending, Superbank is using AI and behaviour data to assess borrowers overlooked by conventional credit scoring, and Wintrust Specialty Finance has deployed AI for credit adjudication.

In risk, Woori Bank is building a generative AI fraud detection system aimed at pre-emptive blocking, while Alfa-Bank has launched Alfa-Scanner to find vulnerabilities in companies' digital infrastructure.
On the client side, Bison Bank is launching Bison Insight to help clients interpret their investments, and M1 has brought AI financial advice to its clients.
